title: Gson tree numbers retain the requested integral wrapper type
summary: The tree retained Byte, Short and Integer for primitive and wrapper declarations. Narrowing integer 257 and byte 1 produced identical Byte values and numeric JSON text.

change.description: The byte, short and integer adapters now select a JsonWriter overload that preserves the narrowed Number class when the destination is a tree.

notes: Java Number.byteValue discards higher bits for an Integer; 257 and 1 have the same low eight bits. Text alone erases wrapper width.
